title: Harschbichlbahn St. Johann in Tirol
highlights: Moderne Gondelbahn hinauf zum Harschbichl auf 1604 Metern direkt unter dem Kitzbueheler Horn
Startpunkt fuer spektakulaere Klettersteige, Bergwanderungen und Mountaincart-Fahrten
Grosser Hornpark Kletterwald an der Mittelstation Angereralm
Grandioser Logenplatz mit direktem Panoramablick auf die schroffen Waende des Wilden Kaisers
kurzbeschreibung: The Harschbichlbahn in St. Johann provides access to the Harschbichl at 1,604 metres, featuring the Hornpark climbing forest, mountaincart track, and Wilder Kaiser views.
beschreibung:
Up to the Sun Balcony on the Kitzbüheler Horn

The Harschbichlbahn takes outdoor enthusiasts from St. Johann in Tirol comfortably up to the 1,604-metre-high Harschbichl in two sections. The top station is located directly on the northern slopes of the Kitzbüheler Horn and is considered one of the finest vantage points in the region.

Adventure, Hiking, and Mountaincart Action

At the middle station, the Hornpark climbing forest thrills visitors with courses situated high in the treetops. From the middle station down to the valley, the winding mountaincart track guarantees exhilarating downhill fun for the entire family against the backdrop of the majestic Wilder Kaiser.
